The '''''Fury of Alderaan''''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that was used to carry members of the [[Ardan resistance]] to [[Jagomir]] after the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]].<ref name="OAA1" />
